description: This Java class creates BSON representations of predicates for MongoDB queries, implementing the PredicateVisitor interface to generate filters based on predicate types.

classes.name: CreateBsonPredicateVisitor
classes.description: A singleton class that implements PredicateVisitor to convert predicates into BSON filters for MongoDB queries.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CreateBsonPredicateVisitor.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter from a predicate and a field name.

methods.name: visitIn
methods.description: Creates an 'in' BSON filter for a list of values.

methods.name: visitLike
methods.description: Creates a regex BSON filter after removing leading/trailing wildcards for performance.

methods.name: removeLeadingOrTrailingWildcard
methods.description: Removes leading '^\Q\E.*' and trailing '.*\Q\E$' wildcards from a string.
